copy.headline: The Fantasia — a party dress with movement in every seam.
copy.description: Made for the hours after dark, the Fantasia moves the way the night should: fluid through the body, easy at the hem, unbothered by dance floors. The third of five pieces in the Recall Collection.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs.
copy.editorialQuote: Half dress, half evening — entirely Fantasia.

fabric.material: Textured grid-weave cotton blend with sculpted bustier bodice
fabric.drapeDescription: Corseted bodice over an asymmetric dropped-waist bubble midi skirt
fabric.finish: Tonal windowpane texture with corset lacing, tie straps and bubble midi hem
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
